result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals or traffic lights. The wide corner radii and lack of vertical separation beyond standard curbs increase exposure for pedestrians in a mixed-use commercial and residential setting.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection has marked crosswalks but no visible stop signs, traffic lights, or pedestrian signals to regulate vehicle flow and provide right-of-way to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radius

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control or Signalization
